notes.title: Update 0.5.8
notes.notes:
Hey there!

A couple of days ago, we dropped a new update! This one’s extra special because the [b]Android version is now available worldwide for the first time![/b] 🎉 Multiplayer, however, is still only available on PC - for now. Don’t worry, it’s coming to mobile eventually.

For now, let’s dive into the most noticeable change in this update: [b]the new health system![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/b282e33bef30d41454bed171d8ccc51b95c1da61.gif[/img]

When you take damage, a health bubble will spawn. You can pick up these bubbles to restore a lost limb. You can also pick up health bubbles spawned by other players. All health bubbles are the same, so grab them while you can.

You’ll still have three health points before you die, just like before. However, when you lose a body part, you’ll start bleeding. If you don’t pick up a health bubble and patch yourself up, you’ll eventually bleed out and die. (Creepy, right?)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/2add5631c02760981c4c9a4f4d969becf00748aa.png[/img]

The more limbs you lose, the faster you’ll bleed out. So, don’t wait around - you’ve got about 10 to 20 seconds to save yourself. Keep in mind that we’re still testing this system, and it needs some polishing, so these numbers might change. Either way, it brings exciting new dynamics to the game, especially on maps like UFO and Boomchicken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/d2cc9a80d4bd633568c4efb036a4d5817bc0813a.png[/img]

While the new health system might steal the spotlight, the [b]biggest change behind the scenes for us has been optimization[/b]. We’ve spent months making sure Chop Chop Guys runs smoothly on mobile with a solid framerate. Our goal is to hit 60 FPS on devices like the Google Pixel 4 and similar hardware.
What does this mean for PC players? The game should now run flawlessly on the Steam Deck! 🚀 Give it a try and let us know what you think on [b]our [url=https://discord.gg/VkzaSC9QGH]Discord server[/url][/b].

Cheers,
The Chop Chop Guys Dev Team
ːnecroheartːːnecroheartːːnecroheartː

notes.title: 0.5.5 Summer update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/fec13f8074bc0a1eafd4d313a63153f3de19d16f.jpg[/img]

Hey there! It's been a while since our last update. We know you're eagerly waiting for new content, especially new levels. And... this update doesn't include them. ːsteamfacepalmː

Wait, what?! How could we spend all this time and not make new levels?!!1 ːsteamfacepalmːːsteamfacepalmːːsteamfacepalmː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/3e651ee2c11aa95293166b2b7a4b409099fd06d7.gif[/img]

Well, we were up to all sorts of things ːchuchelsmileː

Last time, we mentioned that we were working on the Android version of the game, and we're almost done with it. We'll have a separate announcement about that soon. For now, since we're here on Steam, let's dive into what's new in version 0.5.5, which should be available to play now.

[h2]Server Update[/h2]

This is probably the biggest but least noticeable change. We're temporarily moving away from dedicated game servers to a system where one player's computer acts as the server.

There are pros and cons to this. The main advantage is that the game will no longer depend on our available servers. Now, any number of people can play Chop Chop Guys at any time. The downside is that without dedicated servers, cheating might become easier. We'll mark any accounts caught cheating in our database, and before the full release, we'll wipe them. On release, we'll switch back to dedicated servers. So, cheaters will just lose all their progress. Everyone else will keep their progress and get bonus content for participating in the playtest. What content? We don't know yet. ;)

[h2]A Thousand Little Things[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/296a284d8b808121ea2cf80e9ae376b9b22a64e7.jpg[/img]

Since the last update, we've made over 500 commits (changes, fixes, new bugs) to the project repository. Listing them all would be impossible. Just know that the game is now a little better, a little faster, and a little prettier. Our programming machine Alex (also known as "koban") has been fixing and improving things day and night. No one remembers what exactly anymore, so just launch the game and see for yourself.

[h2]Playtest[/h2]

Today, we opened access to the game for everyone who requested it earlier. This playtest will run indefinitely. At least, we don't plan to turn it off in the next month or two. We'll be fixing bugs and adding new features directly to the live game. You can report bugs [url=https://discord.gg/F3pYu2g76u]on our Discord server[/url]. We read all messages almost every day.

That's all for now. See you in the game!

--
Chop Chop Guys
Dev Team

notes.title: Version 0.5.2
notes.notes:
[h2]A Whole New Look for the Nuclear Pillars Map[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WylfSrY.gif[/img]
[h2]New Gameplay Rules for Color Floor[/h2]
We've identified an issue with the Color Floor gameplay where your final position is mostly determined by the last few seconds. We're addressing this by introducing two new features:
[h3]Tiles with Bonus Points[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/6e726961b958211926342a8108a4e417832fdd43.jpg[/img]
[h3]Points Resolution Stages[/h3]
Instead of your final points being equal to the number of colored tiles at the end of the round, we now calculate points three times during the round, at the end of each progress bar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/e8ef00773ff3fbd0e40dc0569a393590f356e72b.jpg[/img]
[h2]Darts[/h2]
We've changed the target points grading to emphasize precision. This adjustment is an intermediate step before a more significant gameplay and aesthetic overhaul in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/a95a81fe69c23d1a93ab77f1e540e670ed142536.jpg[/img]
[h2]Kill Bob Kill[/h2]
The spawn point is now randomized after death, reducing the impact of spawn location on your chances of winning.
We've enhanced bot behavior, making them smarter—prepare accordingly!
A minor fix has been implemented for shooting direction.

[h2]Boomchicken[/h2]
The rate of exploding egg spawns now varies based on the number of players remaining on the map, ensuring a fairer experience towards the round's end.

[h2]UFO[/h2]
Fixed an issue where players could fly away when spawned inside the beam.

[h2]Bobsleigh[/h2]
Fixed missing "blood" decals on the Bobsleigh map and in certain areas of other maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/3ca87cc88c18dcc14f50008165063c333a045fc1.jpg[/img]
[h2]Run Bob Run[/h2]
Improved bot behavior to reduce instances of getting stuck on the map.

[h2]Other Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
Enhanced visual quality in close-up camera scenarios, allowing characters and level geometry to softly fade in and out.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fu1fNyO.gif[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/b11f8303e1169f446d21a1d4884ac7efb0726f98.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/f2d90035121b6a98f8c3f57b1b3cd11caffa5bae.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Playtest #4 This Weekend!
notes.notes:
Hiss… Chop Chop, Guys! We're live!

It's been ages since our last playtest back in May 2023. We've got a ton of new stuff for you! Instead of bombarding you with a lengthy and tedious list of hundreds of little fixes and improvements, we'll keep it short and sweet. Let's dive in!
[h3]Level Art[/h3]
We've crafted some real art for the levels of Run Bob Run and Boom Chicken. With beautiful models and textures. Be sure to let us know what you think about it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/9ca525c586b29040070a51437001c03e8808cede.jpg[/img]
[h3]Party Matchmaking[/h3]
Now you can create a session with your friends from Steam.
[h3]J-Pass[/h3]
For each session, you'll earn experience that turns into J-Pass levels.
At each level, a reward awaits you in the form of costumes, animations, or in-game currency.
In total, there will be 42 levels in J-Pass.
All costumes in the battle pass are unique.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/c22915c89942926d6824e73a189f7dd4b548bc11.jpg[/img]
[h3]Stores[/h3]
In addition to experience, JCash is also rewarded. You can spend it in the in-game store. Costumes, body materials, and emotion animation in the store do not overlap with those in the battle pass.
All items will change over time.
[h3]New Interface[/h3]
We've completely redesigned the main menu. Now it looks a bit more like a real game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/5a0835f55e0effc21e060839f0a783a9cb42cdfd.jpg[/img]
[h3]Emotion Animations[/h3]
We've added several animations that you can set to buttons 1, 2, 3, 4 on the keyboard or D-Pad arrows on the controller in the customization menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/b6b2638763fc44f1b27a62033b162fe137a1b186.gif[/img]
[h3]Costumes and Body Materials[/h3]
Well, and a bunch of new costumes and cool leather materials, which you can find in the J-Pass and store.
[h3]Crowns[/h3]
Right now, it's just a victory counter and nothing more. But you can show off with a large number of crowns to your friends ;)
[h3]Other[/h3]
And literally hundreds of other small changes and bug fixes. The most important of which is that multiplayer should now behave much better. It's not perfect yet, but it's better!

The fourth playtest will begin at 00:00 UTC this Saturday, January 13. It will last for one month. Hurry up and hit the "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008220/Chop_Chop_Guys/]Request Access[/url]" button on the game's Steam page to get an invitation to Chop Chop Guys!
P.S. We also have a [url=https://discord.com/invite/VkzaSC9QGH]Discord community with 600 members[/url] where you can ask about various secrets in the game. Join us!

–
[b]Chop Chop Guys
Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: August update
notes.notes:
Hey there! It's Minsky from Chop Chop Guys. It's been a while since our last playtest, and now it's time to share the latest updates about the development of our game.

During this time, our development team has welcomed some new faces. We've got Alex, a talented Unreal programmer from Germany, Daniel, an artist-designer from Kazakhstan, and a trio of awesome backend programmers – Karina, George, and Sergey. With these new additions, we'll be able to create bugs three times faster and make them look beautiful, thanks to the skills of a true artist. Cheers to that!

We haven't officially announced this yet, so please don't consider this paragraph an official announcement, but we've started experimenting with a mobile version of the game. Besides the opportunity to play on the go, this has actually benefited the PC version due to the optimization work we've done. Our goal is to achieve a solid 60fps at 1080p resolution on any device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/9aa17aaaa91b70ba07a20cc1604f8ac83759e46c.jpg[/img]

Moving on, we've begun enhancing what's commonly known as the meta-game. No, it's not about the metaverse ;) It's all about what happens beyond the core gameplay – when you're navigating through levels, dodging dangerous traps, or outplaying other gamers. There are two specific things we're currently working on: a costume store and a battle pass. If you've joined our previous playtests, you've probably gotten lost in the customization window. Well, we're revamping that window to make it user-friendly and visually appealing. It will be split into two separate interfaces – one for buying costumes and another for your inventory, where you can deck out your character. The battle pass mechanics will act as a progress indicator in the game. At the end of your gaming session, you'll earn experience and J-Cash. Experience leads to levels, which unlock new costumes in the battle pass, and you can spend J-Cash on special items in the store.

Speaking of gaming events, you might have noticed pictures from the Gamescom on our Twitter. Yep! Last week, we showcased Chop Chop Guys at one of the biggest video game exhibitions, and countless people got their hands on it! Special thanks to the Polish Indie Booth, under which the Chop Chop Guys stand was set up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/616336a7d37f17c32bb5798ab2d0fc2f9578aa3c.jpg[/img]

There are two more interesting points related to the gaming expo. You're probably familiar with age ratings like ESRB and PEGI for video games. Well, in Germany, where Gamescom took place, they have their own stricter rating system called USK. If your game doesn't fall under the 16+ category, you can only show it in a closed area or cover it with ominous opaque curtains. Since we couldn't rent an entire space and wanted to showcase Chop Chop Guys to as many players as possible, we took a daring step and changed all the blood in the game to purple. We want to hear from you about how this change has impacted the game. So, here's the deal...

We've launched a demo version! Yep, no need to wait for the playtest – you can try the game out anytime now. The demo version has just one limitation for now – multiplayer won't be available. That's why we'll continue to run playtests, so you can team up with your buddies or play with random folks from the internet. We'll let you know separately when the next playtest is happening. Stay tuned!

–
Chop Chop Guys
Dev Team

notes.title: Playtest #3 is coming!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi again, choppers! [/h1]

Get ready for some serious fun, as [b]starting May 24th[/b], we’re flinging open the game doors to the public. But note that you've got a [b]limited time window of just 5 days[/b] to soak it all in. So make sure not to miss a beat! 

Now, what's the scoop on this epic update, you ask? Well, hold onto your seats because we've got some mind-blowing goodies lined up just for you!

[h1]Version 0.2.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]We’ve added Score game mode! [/h2]
No more “Back to the main menu and start matchmaking again. Just pure fun from start to end!

In each round, you'll earn points just by playing. Now, here's where the excitement kicks in: on "race" maps, the speedy finishers will snatch up extra points, so it's all about crossing that finish line in record time! On the flip side, on "survival" maps, the longer you manage to hold on, the more points you'll gather.

But wait, there's more! It's not just about one round—oh no! We're taking it to the next level. Over the course of four rounds, you'll accumulate your scores. And guess what? The player with the highest total score at the end of it all takes home the glorious victory!

[h2]We are finally launching a Multiplayer![/h2]

As we’ve mentioned in our last Playtest, Chop Chop Guys is meant to be a multiplayer game. And we are excited to share with you adding multiplayer in the game!

However, this is our first iteration of this groundbreaking feature and we’re still in the testing phase, so bear with us. 

Now, we're still cooking up a party mode to take things to the next level, but trust us, it's in the works. Stay tuned for even more multiplayer madness coming your way!

[h2]New costumes added![/h2]

Dress your Bobs to impress, and let the cuteness and laughter ensue! We have 4 exciting new costumes for you this time.

And here’s a sneak peek at new options for customizing your lovely Bob

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/4ee5193450c5afae3d8874275d6822890920bd45.png[/img]

[h2]New UFO level[/h2]

Embark on an extraterrestrial adventure with our thrilling new UFO level! 

Picture this: a mischievous UFO, equipped with a powerful sucking ray, is on a mission to capture you. But you're not going down without a fight, are you? Keep collecting those precious points by staying in the ray on the edge of being sucked up. It's a balancing act like no other!

So buckle up, because the UFO level is about to take you on a wild ride. Remember, in this crazy universe, the points keep coming for you being in the beam while resisting the alien allure. May the force be with you, and let the UFO madness begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/8cbd3078c9c8eb5a192f287fbdfc6ab502b7c6fb.png[/img]

[h2]Musical theme added for each level[/h2]

We kept our promise and made beautifully handcrafted music for each game level. So grab those headphones, crank up the volume, and get ready to groove to the rhythm of the game.
We can't wait to see you rockin' and rollin' to the beats we've lovingly created for you!

[h2]And a small reminder on how to participate[/h2]

Don't forget to request access (green button on the game's Steam page) and just wait until [b]Wednesday, May 24th 20:00 CET[/b]. If you still have questions, you could ask them on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2008220/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/VkzaSC9QGH]official Discord Server[/url]. 

Phew, we've bombarded you with a ton of awesome updates, but don't worry, we've got your back. Make sure to take a good look at all these mind-blowing additions we've cooked up for this Playtest. We can't wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
In January and February, we held two closed playtests. We found out that people like our game, which motivates us to continue working and improving the project. Today, we want to share our upcoming plans.

For a long time, we thought about the pros and cons of the Battle Royale mode. It provides a storm of emotions during gameplay. At every moment, you're on the edge of losing, your adrenaline is pumping, and it's really great. And it works really well in games like PUBG and Fortnite, where you play in one big continuous session. However, in the case of a game like Chop Chop Guys, where the session consists of several alternating rounds, it's very frustrating to lose on a map that you don't like, even though you could show everyone how good you are on the next maps. But even that's not the most important thing. Battle Royale has a huge problem when you want to play with your friends. After all, the only thing better than multiplayer is multiplayer with friends. And you want to play with your friends from start to finish. That's why we decided to make another game mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/5fb727dea8b7e22a95f07c470082125afa98c0f8.jpg[/img]

We've already been experimenting with the new mode for a couple of weeks, and we'll be ready to show it at the next closed testing (playtest). We're still deciding when we can show it. Maybe in April, maybe in May, at the same time as the launch of the multiplayer version (spoiler!).

The essence of this mode is quite simple: you earn points for playing in one round. Whoever finishes first gets more points for "race" maps, and vice versa, whoever drops out earlier gets fewer points for "survival" maps. Whoever scores the most points over four rounds wins. Right now, we're testing this with 12 players in one session, and it's playing great. We hope you'll like it too!

In the next note, we'll tell you about the new cool UFO map that we also want to include in the next playtest. Stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=ux40TdnNUVc;full][/previewyoutube]

--
Chop Chop Guys Team

notes.title: Alert! Playtest #2 is coming!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Starting this Friday until Sunday midnight, you can play Chop Chop Guys all around the world! Just hit the green “Request Access” button [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008220/Chop_Chop_Guys/]on the Steam page[/url] and you'll get an email when the playtest goes live.

We've spent a month cleaning up the project. Fun fact, the first build was approximately 1GB, but we managed to reduce it to just 300MB without losing any content. Well, we did lose a couple of textures here and there (ten points for those who notice where), but we'll find them for the next update ;)

There are three new costumes in this update. Aren't they cute?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/11340b838787501853dc73dfdc7c1e52abe3546e.gif[/img]

You may also notice from the previous playtest that we're using the same musical theme for all our levels, except for maybe the main menu. Of course, we want (and will) have a unique theme for each game level. In this update, we've prepared the first one for the Bobsleigh level. With time, we'll make a beautifully handcrafted music theme for every single one of them.

Despite 250+ commits in our repository and 70+ tasks closed in our task tracker since January 8th, there are still many bugs and not much content. How is that possible, huh? Well, before going into full-speed content production, we must resolve so-called “technical debt.” Also, you may notice that Chop Chop Guys is meant to be an online multiplayer title. For a long time, we've been working on two separate branches: multiplayer and singleplayer with bots. We needed the latter so we could deliver the game prototype to you as soon as possible. January was when we merged these versions into a single codebase. The multiplayer still won't be available during this playtest, but we're just a few steps behind it.

One more thing. During the previous playtest, we noticed that PCs fans get really noisy when running Chop Chop Guys. That was because we forgot to enable VSync by default, so the game was basically running at an unlimited FPS rate. Now VSync will be turned on by default, so the game's framerate will be limited to your screen refresh rate. Usually, it's 60Hz, 75Hz, 144Hz, etc.

So, what should you do now? Don't forget to request access (green button on the game's Steam page) and just wait until Friday, February 17th. If you still have questions, you could ask them on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2008220/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] or in our official [url=https://discord.gg/k6KZDE6WjQ]Discord Server[/url]. Cheers!

P.S. Happy Valentine's Day!

notes.title: Playtest #1 Wrap-up
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! On January 8th, we wrapped up our first playtest for Chop Chop Guys and we wanted to share some of the results with you as well as let you know our next plans.

Initially, we had planned for just a couple of our friends and acquaintances to come and play the game with us, just to make sure it runs on different computers. But we were curious to see how streamers on Twitch would react to Chop Chop Guys, so we reached out to a small list of streamers who recently streamed games similar to ours. Out of the 20 people we contacted, 9 responded and it was really cool! Some of them immediately streamed the game, recorded videos or made TikTok clips. Seeing other people take an interest in something you've been working on for a long time is really motivating! To make things even more exciting, one of them showed the game to their friend, who turned out to be TheNinjaProXD. He started streaming Chop Chop Guys on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/theninjaproxd_]his channel[/url] and even posted a link to [url=https://discord.gg/VkzaSC9QGH]our Discord server[/url] in his chat. As a result, our Discord server grew from practically nothing to 150 people! Another guy, monodemando, also posted a link to us on [url=https://discord.gg/K8zaKqAhsC]his Discord server[/url] and we got a few more people from there too. Now, both monodemando and TheNinjaProXD are helping us with moderating the server, for which we are incredibly grateful. In the end, instead of a few of our friends, over 1200 people signed up for the playtest, with 800 of them actually playing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/6ba481d0c434103aaebda8720c3f3a8c1485bb8e.png[/img]

Interestingly, the majority of the players were from the Spanish-speaking community. This is probably because Spanish-speaking streamers were the most active in responding to our call to show the game before the playtest began.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/1b200831461624d982facea5ee32dfb9f10d7bd5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43399828/43975a7bff24c7499430a86a65dd95bca7e90cf7.png[/img]

Just to clarify, what exactly we were testing during the Playtest. To avoid confusion with terms like Alpha version or Beta version, let's just say that the version we tested is at least one year away from the full release of the game. Essentially, this was the first playable prototype, where the basic game mechanics (movement, dash, pushing) are working and there's a minimal set of levels to convey the essence of the game.

[h3]What We Took Away from the Playtest Results[/h3]

[list]
[*] The overwhelming majority of feedback was overwhelmingly positive. People are really enjoying the game. Yeah!
[*] Not many people understood that this was not a finished game, but rather a barely functioning prototype. We'll have to prepare the announcements better in the future. But can you imagine what it will be like when we're finished?
[*] A couple of silly bugs. For example, v-sync was turned off by default, which caused some computer fans to make noise (because the game doesn't limit FPS and the video card is working at maximum capacity).
[*] Many requested a mobile version. Currently, we're not thinking about it. We plan to develop the game exclusively on Steam for at least the next 6 months.
[*] Everyone wants more maps and costumes. Definitely. We're already working on new maps and costumes.
[*] The game is difficult. For now, we're not doing anything about it. We'll see how quickly players progress from "this is incredibly difficult" to "this is too easy, can we get something more serious?
[/list]

[h3]What We'll Be Doing Next and What We're Doing Right Now[/h3]

Going forward from the first prototype and based on your feedback, we'll be moving ahead with 2 or 4-week iterations. We're not sure yet how quickly we'll be able to release new updates, but we'll figure that out as we go. In each update, we'll be working on specific parts of the game such as multiplayer, controller support, finalizing graphics for certain levels or adding new levels, etc. Once an update is ready, we'll be running a new playtest, usually starting on Thursday evening and ending on Sunday night. This is how we'll be developing Chop Chop Guys for the next six months.

Right now, we're working on various improvements to the game's internal workings that we've been putting off for a while. It'll take another couple of weeks. Unfortunately, from the player's perspective, this won't result in a significant visible outcome, but it's essential that we do this now so that development can proceed faster in the future. Among other less noticeable things, we'll fix bugs that we saw during the first playtest, ensure good support for different gamepads, and create a couple of new skins. 

That's it for today. What can you do while you wait for the next playtest to begin? For example, you can subscribe to [url=https://twitter.com/chopchopguys]our Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/chopchopguysgame/]Instagram [/url]where we post funny pictures of the development process and where you'll also be able to follow important news about the project.

Cheers!
Chop Chop Guys Dev Team

notes.title: Happy New Year! Happy Playtesting!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! We wish you only the best games this year! And speaking of the best games, here is our attempt at creating one. "Chop Chop Guys" is a bizarre competition of bizarre characters in a bizarre world. We started developing the game with this tagline. If you've already seen [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fGqxvXxjUEI]the prototype trailer[/url], you might have an idea of the main sources of inspiration: the Squid Game television series and a popular game about falling beans. Our goal is to create a game that you can just jump into and have fun from the second you start playing. No complicated rules, no overloaded interfaces, just pure fun guiding a clunky character through a deadly trial course. Did we succeed? You decide!

We will start the playtest on [b]January 5th and continue until January 8th[/b] To apply for the playtest, just click the green "Request Access" button on our store page.

After you play, please leave a few words about your thoughts on the game in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2008220/discussions/1/3726198239762076775/]Steam forum.[/url] With your help, we can make the best game possible! See you in the game. Thanks for reading and good luck!

--
Bob
